title: Unreal 2 Passionfruit and Grapefruit 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Drench your senses in sweet and tangy tropical flavours with Unreal 2’s Passionfruit and Grapefruit flavour e-liquid. The rich, deep sweetness of passionfruit plays perfectly with the bright, citrus tang of grapefruit for an irresistibly sweet and uplifting tropical vape. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mods and sub-ohm tanks .
